messages:
marta: Noticed the /v1/rerank endpoint examples are inconsistent: OpenAPI sample uses `queries: []` while the JS snippet sends `inputs: []`. Quickstart curl fails.

owen: which files?

marta: docs/api/rerank.md, docs/samples/rerank_openapi.json, snippets/js/rerank_quickstart.md.

jay: Ah, rename fallout. We decided on `queries` as the canonical field earlier. Let's standardize to `queries` everywhere.

marta: also the OpenAPI response example includes `scores` as strings ("0.87") instead of numbers. docs-lint flagged it.

lint-bot: CI: sample validator error docs/samples/rerank_openapi.json line 24: type mismatch for `scores` (expected number array).

owen: simple fixes: change `inputs` -> `queries` in JS snippet, adjust curl example body, and convert `scores` to numeric values. I'll also add a one-line note in rerank.md: "Field: queries (array[string]) - previously `inputs` in older examples."

jay: please add a small test in CI that validates sample types against schema when samples change.

owen: will do. Pushing branch `docs/rerank-sample-fix-3755550000` with commits `use-queries-in-snippets` and `fix-score-types`. Linking PR when ready.

marta: thanks. Marking this as high priority since quickstart failing.

owen: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4955. Preview queued.

lint-bot: Preview build passed. No further errors.

jay: merged and added changelog: "docs: normalize rerank payload field to `queries`, correct score types in examples"

marta: verified the quickstart works. closing.
